entries.example_en: We are looking forward to seeing you next week.
entries.example_zh: 我们盼着下周见到你。

entries.example_en: Don't give up! You can do it if you try again.
entries.example_zh: 别放弃！再试一次你就能做到。

entries.example_en: All the students took part in the cleaning activity.
entries.example_zh: 全体学生参加了清洁活动。

entries.example_en: He ran fast to catch up with his friends.
entries.example_zh: 他跑得很快，好赶上朋友们。

entries.example_en: We have run out of milk, so I'll buy some after school.
entries.example_zh: 我们的牛奶喝完了，所以放学后我去买一些。

entries.example_en: She came up with a great idea for the project.
entries.example_zh: 她为这个项目想出了一个好主意。

entries.example_en: Our car broke down on the way to the airport.
entries.example_zh: 我们的车在去机场的路上抛锚了。

entries.example_en: They put off the meeting until next Friday.
entries.example_zh: 他们把会议推迟到下周五。

entries.example_en: Students look up to teachers who are kind and patient.
entries.example_zh: 学生们敬仰善良又有耐心的老师。

entries.example_en: He gets along well with all his classmates.
entries.example_zh: 他和所有同学都相处融洽。

entries.example_en: Can you look after my little brother for an hour?
entries.example_zh: 你能帮我照看弟弟一个小时吗？

entries.example_en: My uncle set up a small bookshop in our town.
entries.example_zh: 我叔叔在我们镇上开了一家小书店。

entries.example_en: He turned down my invitation because he was busy.
entries.example_zh: 他因为忙而拒绝了我的邀请。

entries.example_en: After arguing for an hour, Tom finally gave in.
entries.example_zh: 争论了一个小时后，汤姆终于让步了。

entries.example_en: Carry on with your homework — I'll be back soon.
entries.example_zh: 继续做作业，我很快就回来。

entries.meaning_zh: 克服；从（疾病、打击）中恢复
entries.example_en: It took her a week to get over the flu.
entries.example_zh: 她花了一周时间才从流感中恢复过来。

entries.example_en: Mary takes after her father in both looks and character.
entries.example_zh: 玛丽在外貌和性格上都像她父亲。

entries.example_en: I came across this old photo while cleaning my desk.
entries.example_zh: 我整理书桌时偶然发现了这张旧照片。

entries.example_en: His grandparents brought him up in a small village.
entries.example_zh: 他的祖父母在一个小村庄里把他抚养长大。

entries.example_en: I can't put up with the noise any longer.
entries.example_zh: 我再也无法忍受这噪音了。

entries.meaning_zh: 出现；到场；把（音量等）调大
entries.example_en: He promised to come, but he didn't turn up until eight o'clock.
entries.example_zh: 他答应要来，但直到八点才出现。

entries.example_en: Put on your coat — it's cold outside.
entries.example_zh: 把外套穿上，外面很冷。

entries.meaning_zh: （飞机）起飞；脱下；（事业）迅速走红
entries.example_en: The plane took off on time despite the heavy rain.
entries.example_zh: 尽管下着大雨，飞机还是准时起飞了。

entries.example_en: I need to find out when the train leaves.
entries.example_zh: 我需要查明火车什么时候发车。

entries.example_en: Look out! The floor is wet.
entries.example_zh: 当心！地板是湿的。

entries.example_en: A strange question came up during the interview.
entries.example_zh: 面试中出现了一个奇怪的问题。

entries.example_en: He was ill for a month and fell behind in his studies.
entries.example_zh: 他病了一个月，学习落下了。

entries.example_en: The football match was called off because of the storm.
entries.example_zh: 由于暴风雨，足球赛被取消了。

entries.meaning_zh: 解决；算出；（情况）发展顺利；锻炼
entries.example_en: Don't worry — everything will work out fine in the end.
entries.example_zh: 别担心，最后一切都会顺利解决的。

entries.meaning_zh: 顺便到访；（不久）恢复；转变看法
entries.example_en: Why don't you come round for dinner this weekend?
entries.example_zh: 这周末为什么不顺便来我家吃饭呢？

entries.example_en: Cheer up! The exam is over and you did your best.
entries.example_zh: 振作点！考试结束了，你已经尽力了。

entries.example_en: Please hand in your homework before Friday.
entries.example_zh: 请在周五之前上交作业。

entries.example_en: The teacher went over the main points again before the exam.
entries.example_zh: 考试前，老师又把要点复习了一遍。

entries.example_en: He walks so fast that I can hardly keep up with him.
entries.example_zh: 他走得太快了，我几乎跟不上他。

entries.example_en: I ran into an old friend at the supermarket yesterday.
entries.example_zh: 昨天我在超市偶遇了一位老朋友。

entries.example_en: The teacher pointed out several mistakes in my essay.
entries.example_zh: 老师指出了我作文中的几处错误。

entries.example_en: The party turned out to be a great success.
entries.example_zh: 这次聚会结果非常成功。

entries.example_en: He drives his new car around just to show off.
entries.example_zh: 他开着自己的新车到处转，只是为了炫耀。

entries.example_en: I think I'm coming down with a cold.
entries.example_zh: 我觉得自己好像感冒了。

entries.example_en: We need to sort out this problem as soon as possible.
entries.example_zh: 我们需要尽快解决这个问题。

entries.meaning_zh: 捡起；接某人；学会（技能、语言）
entries.example_en: It's getting late — who is going to pick up the kids from school today?
entries.example_zh: 天快黑了——今天谁去学校接孩子们？

entries.example_en: She tried on three dresses before choosing the blue one.
entries.example_zh: 她试穿了三条裙子，最后选了蓝色的那条。

entries.example_en: Please write down your name and phone number on this form.
entries.example_zh: 请在这张表格上写下你的姓名和电话号码。

entries.example_en: Don't throw away those old boxes; we can use them again.
entries.example_zh: 别把那些旧箱子扔掉，我们还能再用。

entries.example_en: My alarm goes off at six every morning, even on weekends.
entries.example_zh: 我的闹钟每天早上六点响，周末也不例外。

entries.meaning_zh: 开始从事（某项爱好）；占用（时间、空间）
entries.example_en: He took up painting last year and now spends every weekend at his easel.
entries.example_zh: 他去年开始学画画，现在每个周末都在画架前度过。

entries.example_en: We set off early to avoid the traffic on the motorway.
entries.example_zh: 我们很早就出发了，以避开高速公路上的车流。

entries.meaning_zh: 免费赠送；无意中泄露（秘密）
entries.example_en: The company gives away free samples outside the supermarket.
entries.example_zh: 那家公司在超市门口免费发放样品。

entries.meaning_zh: 编造（故事、借口）；（吵架后）和好
entries.example_en: He made up an excuse for being late, but nobody believed him.
entries.example_zh: 他为迟到编了个借口，但没有人相信他。

entries.example_en: The police are looking into the cause of the accident.
entries.example_zh: 警方正在调查事故的原因。

entries.example_en: The little seed turned into a tall sunflower over the summer.
entries.example_zh: 整个夏天，这颗小种子长成了一株高高的向日葵。

entries.example_en: Work hard, and your dream of becoming a pilot will come true.
entries.example_zh: 努力学习，你成为飞行员的梦想就会实现。

entries.example_en: I found the missing key by accident while cleaning the desk.
entries.example_zh: 我擦桌子时无意中找到了丢失的钥匙。

entries.example_en: Please keep an eye on my little brother while I'm out.
entries.example_zh: 我出去的时候，请帮我照看一下弟弟。

entries.example_en: You should get rid of the bad habit of staying up late.
entries.example_zh: 你应该改掉熬夜的坏习惯。

entries.example_en: Fill in your name and address at the top of the form.
entries.example_zh: 在表格顶端填上你的姓名和地址。

entries.example_en: He promised to help us, and he didn't let us down.
entries.example_zh: 他答应帮我们，也确实没有让我们失望。

entries.example_en: She put forward a good idea at the class meeting.
entries.example_zh: 她在班会上提出了一个好主意。

entries.example_en: The family went through hard times after the father lost his job.
entries.example_zh: 父亲失业后，一家人经历了艰难的岁月。

entries.meaning_zh: 减少，削减（吸烟、吃糖等的量）
entries.example_en: The doctor advised him to cut down on sugar and salt.
entries.example_zh: 医生建议他减少糖和盐的摄入。

entries.example_en: What do you want to be when you grow up?
entries.example_zh: 你长大后想做什么？

entries.example_en: Please make sure the windows are closed before you leave.
entries.example_zh: 离开前请确保窗户都关好了。

entries.example_en: Don't stay up too late playing games before the exam.
entries.example_zh: 考试前别熬夜打游戏到太晚。

entries.example_en: We don't feel like cooking tonight, so let's eat out.
entries.example_zh: 今晚我们不想做饭，出去吃吧。

entries.example_en: I heard from my pen friend in Canada last week.
entries.example_zh: 上周我收到了加拿大笔友的来信。

entries.example_en: Everyone was singing, and soon she joined in.
entries.example_zh: 大家都在唱歌，她很快就加入了。

entries.example_en: The teacher asked me to give out the test papers.
entries.example_zh: 老师让我分发试卷。

entries.example_en: Check your list again — you've left out one important name.
entries.example_zh: 再检查一下你的清单——你漏掉了一个重要的名字。

entries.meaning_zh: 最终成为（或处于某种状态）
entries.example_en: He studied law, but he ended up working as a teacher.
entries.example_zh: 他学的是法律，最后却做了老师。

entries.example_en: He told a funny story to break the ice at the party.
entries.example_zh: 他在聚会上讲了个有趣的故事来缓和气氛。

entries.example_en: I can't figure out how to solve this maths problem.
entries.example_zh: 我搞不懂这道数学题怎么解。

entries.example_en: They manage to get by on a very small income.
entries.example_zh: 他们靠微薄的收入勉强维持生活。

entries.meaning_zh: 稍等一下；（打电话时）别挂断
entries.example_en: Hold on a moment, please. I'll get a pen.
entries.example_zh: 请稍等一下，我去拿支笔。

entries.example_en: You shouldn't look down on people who are poorer than you.
entries.example_zh: 你不应该看不起比你穷的人。

entries.example_en: She worked hard at the weekend to make up for the time she had lost.
entries.example_zh: 她周末努力工作，以弥补之前损失的时间。

entries.example_en: All his years of training finally paid off when he won the race.
entries.example_zh: 多年的训练终于有了回报，他赢得了比赛。

entries.example_en: Can you pick out your mother in this old photo?
entries.example_zh: 你能在这张老照片里认出你妈妈吗？

entries.example_en: The thief ran away when he saw the police.
entries.example_zh: 小偷一看见警察就逃跑了。

entries.example_en: Her son will take over the family business when she retires.
entries.example_zh: 她退休后，儿子将接管家族生意。

entries.example_en: The players warm up for twenty minutes before every match.
entries.example_zh: 每场比赛前，球员们热身二十分钟。

questions.stem: I really ____ the summer holiday. I can't wait!
questions.explain: look forward to（doing）sth. 意为“期待、盼望（做）某事”，与后句“迫不及待”呼应。

questions.stem: What does the phrase 'give up' mean?
questions.explain: give up 意为“放弃”，后接名词或动名词。

questions.stem: Many students want to ____ the school sports meeting next month.
questions.explain: take part in 意为“参加（活动、比赛等）”，强调亲身参与。

questions.stem: What does the phrase 'catch up with' mean?
questions.explain: catch up with 意为“赶上、追上（某人）”，也可指在学习或进度上赶上。

questions.stem: I can't buy the new book because I have ____ my money.
questions.explain: run out of 意为“用完、耗尽”，主语通常是人；买不起书是因为“钱花光了”。

questions.stem: What does the phrase 'come up with' mean?
questions.explain: come up with 意为“想出、提出（主意、办法等）”，相当于 think of。

questions.stem: Our car ____ on the way to the airport, so we missed the flight.
questions.explain: break down 指车辆或机器“出故障、抛锚”，误机说明车坏了，此处用过去式 broke down。

questions.stem: What does the phrase 'put off' mean?
questions.explain: put off 意为“推迟、延期”，后接名词或动名词作宾语。

questions.stem: Young players ____ their coach and hope to be like him one day.
questions.explain: look up to sb. 意为“尊敬、钦佩某人”，想成为教练那样的人说明是钦佩。

questions.stem: What does the phrase 'get along with' mean?
questions.explain: get along with sb. 意为“与某人相处（融洽）”，常与 well 或 badly 连用。

questions.stem: Could you ______ my cat this weekend? I'm going to Shanghai.
questions.explain: look after 意为"照顾、照料"，此处指帮忙照看猫。

questions.stem: Which Chinese meaning matches the phrase "set up"?
questions.explain: set up 意为"建立、创办"，如 set up a company（创办公司）。

questions.stem: She ______ the job offer because the salary was too low.
questions.explain: turn down 意为"拒绝"，此处指她拒绝了一份工作邀请。

questions.stem: In the sentence "The little boy kept crying, and his mother finally gave in", what does "give in" mean?
questions.explain: give in 意为"让步、屈服"，指妈妈最终妥协了。

questions.stem: After a short break, the students ______ with their experiment.
questions.explain: carry on (with) 意为"继续进行"，指休息后继续做实验。

questions.stem: Which Chinese meaning matches the phrase "get over"?
questions.explain: get over 意为"克服（困难）、从（疾病或打击）中恢复"。

questions.stem: Everyone says Lucy ______ her mother — they both have big bright eyes.
questions.explain: take after 意为"（外貌或性格）像（某位家人）"。

questions.stem: In the sentence "I came across an old friend at the supermarket", what does "come across" mean?
questions.explain: come across 意为"偶然遇见、偶然发现"。

questions.stem: She was ______ by her grandparents in the countryside.
questions.explain: bring up 意为"抚养、养育"，被动语态 be brought up 表示"被抚养长大"。

questions.stem: Which is the correct meaning of "put up with"?
questions.explain: put up with 意为"忍受、容忍（不愉快的人或事）"。

questions.stem: We waited for an hour, but Sam never ____ at the party.
questions.explain: turn up 表示“出现、到场”，句意是 Sam 一直没有出现。

questions.stem: Which Chinese meaning matches the phrase 'put on'?
questions.explain: put on 的核心含义是“穿上、戴上”，也可指“增加体重”。

questions.stem: The plane will ____ in twenty minutes, so let's hurry to the gate.
questions.explain: take off 表示“（飞机）起飞”，与赶去登机口的语境相符。

questions.stem: Which Chinese meaning matches the phrase 'find out'?
questions.explain: find out 指经过询问或调查后“查明、弄清楚”某个信息。

questions.stem: ____! There's a car coming!
questions.explain: Look out 用于提醒别人“当心、小心”即将发生的危险。

questions.stem: In the sentence 'A problem came up during the meeting', what does 'come up' mean?
questions.explain: come up 在此处表示“（问题等）出现、被提到”。

questions.stem: If you don't review your lessons regularly, you will ____ the other students.
questions.explain: fall behind 意为“落后、跟不上”，与不复习功课的语境相符。

questions.stem: In the sentence 'They called off the match because of the rain', what does 'call off' mean?
questions.explain: call off 意为“取消”活动或计划，因下雨取消比赛符合句意。

questions.stem: I'm sure you can ____ this maths problem if you think carefully.
questions.explain: work out 在此表示“解出、算出”问题，与数学题的语境相符。

questions.stem: In the sentence 'Why don't you come round to my house tonight?', what does 'come round' mean?
questions.explain: come round 在此指“顺便到某人家拜访”，是口语常用义。

questions.stem: You look sad. ____! Everything will be fine soon.
questions.explain: cheer up 意为“振作起来”，用于安慰难过的人，其余选项不符合语境。

questions.stem: What does 'hand in' mean in the sentence "Please hand in your homework before Friday"?
questions.explain: hand in 意为“上交，提交”，句中指周五前交作业。

questions.stem: Before the exam, we spent a whole lesson ____ the key grammar points so that we could remember them better.
questions.explain: go over 意为“复习、仔细检查”，考前花一节课复习语法要点符合句意。

questions.stem: In "He walks so fast that I can hardly keep up with him", what does 'keep up with' mean?
questions.explain: keep up with 意为“跟上，不落后于”，句中指几乎跟不上他的速度。

questions.stem: I ____ my primary school teacher on the street yesterday; we hadn't met for years.
questions.explain: run into 意为“偶然遇见”，多年未见正好对应偶遇的语境。

questions.stem: Which Chinese meaning matches 'point out' in "The teacher pointed out several mistakes in my essay"?
questions.explain: point out 意为“指出”，句中指老师指出作文里的错误。

questions.stem: The concert we worried about ____ to be a huge success in the end.
questions.explain: turn out (to be) 意为“结果是，原来是”，表示演唱会最终大获成功。

questions.stem: 'show off' in "He drives his new car around just to show off" means ____.
questions.explain: show off 意为“炫耀”，开新车到处转正是为了卖弄。

questions.stem: Tom didn't come to school because he had ____ a bad cold.
questions.explain: come down with 意为“患上、染上（小病）”，因感冒没来上学符合句意。

questions.stem: 'sort out' in "We need to sort out this problem as soon as possible" means ____.
questions.explain: sort out 意为“解决，处理好”，句中指尽快解决问题。

questions.stem: It's getting late — who is going to ____ the kids from school today?
questions.explain: pick up 有“接某人”的意思，句意为“谁去学校接孩子”。

questions.stem: What does the phrase 'try on' mean?
questions.explain: try on 指试穿衣服、鞋子等，看是否合适。

questions.stem: The teacher asked us to ____ the main points of the lesson in our notebooks.
questions.explain: write down 意为“写下、记下”，符合“把要点记在笔记本上”的语境。

questions.stem: What does the phrase 'throw away' mean?
options: B. 开始从事（某项爱好）
questions.explain: throw away 指把不要的东西扔掉、丢弃。

questions.stem: I finally got out of bed when my alarm ____ at half past six.
questions.explain: go off 专指闹钟“响起来”，主语是闹钟时要用 went off。

questions.stem: What does the phrase 'take up' mean?
options: D. 开始从事（某项爱好）；占用（时间、空间）
questions.explain: take up 可指开始一项新爱好，也可指占用时间或空间。

questions.stem: We should ____ early tomorrow morning to miss the heavy traffic.
questions.explain: set off 意为“出发、动身”，句意为“我们该早点出发避开堵车”。

questions.stem: What does the phrase 'give away' mean?
options: C. 免费赠送；无意中泄露（秘密）
questions.explain: give away 既可指免费送出东西，也可指不小心泄露秘密。

questions.stem: Tom ____ a long excuse for being late, but the teacher didn't believe a word.
questions.explain: make up an excuse 表示“编造借口”，老师不信说明是编的。

questions.stem: What does the phrase 'look into' mean?
questions.explain: look into 意为“调查、研究”某件事，常用于警方或机构调查。

questions.stem: The caterpillar will ____ a beautiful butterfly in a few weeks.
questions.explain: turn into 意为"变成"，毛虫会在几周内变成蝴蝶，其余选项含义不符。

questions.stem: What does "come true" mean?
questions.explain: come true 指"（梦想、愿望）实现、成真"，与 C 项释义一致。

questions.stem: Could you ____ my bag for a minute while I buy the tickets?
questions.explain: keep an eye on 表示"照看、留意"，句意是买票时帮忙照看一下包。

questions.stem: What does "by accident" mean?
questions.explain: by accident 意为"偶然、无意地"，正好与 A 项"故意地"意思相反。

questions.stem: We'd better ____ these old boxes to make room for the new sofa.
questions.explain: get rid of 表示"处理掉、清除"，与"给新沙发腾地方"相呼应。

questions.stem: What does "fill in" mean?
questions.explain: fill in 常用于填写表格或空格处，A 项释义正确。

questions.stem: I promised to help him move house, so I really can't ____ him ____.
questions.explain: let sb down 意为"让某人失望"，答应了帮忙就不能失信。

questions.stem: What does "put forward" mean?
questions.explain: put forward 表示"提出（建议、想法等）"，常与 suggestion、idea 等搭配。

questions.stem: After losing her job, she had to ____ a very difficult time.
questions.explain: go through a difficult time 表示"经历艰难时期"，强调经受某种困境。

questions.stem: What does "cut down on" mean?
options: A. 减少，削减（如吸烟、吃糖的量）
questions.explain: cut down on 表示"减少……的量"，医生建议少摄入糖和盐，故 A 正确。

questions.stem: What do you want to be when you ____?
questions.explain: grow up 意为“长大”，句意为“你长大后想成为什么？”其余选项均不符合句意。

questions.stem: What does the phrase 'make sure' mean?
questions.explain: make sure 表示“确保、务必做到”，如 Please make sure the door is locked.

questions.stem: You shouldn't ____ too late before the exam, or you'll feel sleepy tomorrow.
questions.explain: stay up 意为“熬夜”，句意为“考试前不该熬夜太晚，否则明天会犯困”。

questions.stem: What does 'eat out' mean?
options: A. 打破僵局，缓和气氛
questions.explain: eat out 指去餐馆吃饭而不是在家做饭。

questions.stem: It's always exciting to ____ old friends after many years.
questions.explain: hear from sb 意为“收到某人的来信或消息”，句意为“多年后收到老朋友的来信总是令人兴奋”。

questions.stem: What does 'join in' mean?
questions.explain: join in 指加入正在进行的活动、讨论或游戏。

questions.stem: The teacher asked me to ____ the test papers to the class.
questions.explain: give out 意为“分发”，句意为“老师让我把试卷发下去”。

questions.stem: What does 'leave out' mean?
questions.explain: leave out 表示“遗漏、漏掉（不该省略的内容）”。

questions.stem: If you keep spending money like this, you'll ____ with nothing in the bank.
questions.explain: end up (with...) 意为“最终落得……的结果”，句意为“再这样花钱你最终会身无分文”。

questions.stem: What does 'break the ice' mean?
options: B. 打破僵局，缓和气氛
questions.explain: break the ice 指在陌生或尴尬的场合开口说话以缓和气氛。

questions.stem: I can't ____ why she changed her mind so suddenly.
questions.explain: figure out 意为“弄清楚、想出”，句意是“我搞不懂她为何突然改变主意”。

questions.stem: What does "get by" mean?
options: C. 勉强应付过去；过得去
questions.explain: get by 指靠有限的钱或能力勉强应付过去。

questions.stem: What does "hold on" mean?
questions.explain: hold on 常用于口语，表示“稍等”或电话中“别挂断”。

questions.stem: It's wrong to ____ people just because they have less money than you.
questions.explain: look down on 意为“看不起”，句意为“因别人钱少就轻视他们是错误的”。

questions.stem: He bought her some flowers to ____ for their terrible argument.
questions.explain: make up for 意为“弥补”，句意是“买花来弥补那场争吵”。

questions.stem: What does "pay off" mean?
options: A. 得到好结果；有回报
questions.explain: pay off 指努力或投入最终得到好结果、有回报。

questions.stem: The teacher asked us to ____ the main ideas in the text and underline them.
questions.explain: pick out 意为“挑选出、辨认出”，句意为“挑出文章主旨并画线”。

questions.stem: What does "run away" mean?
questions.explain: run away 意为“逃跑、跑开”。

questions.stem: A big company is going to ____ our small factory next year.
questions.explain: take over 意为“接管”，句意为“大公司将接管我们的小工厂”。

questions.stem: What does "warm up" mean?
questions.explain: warm up 指运动前热身，也可指天气变暖。
